import json
h,w=26,22
g=[[8]*w for _ in range(h)]
# Three zero canvases
for r in range(2,11):
    for c in range(3,9): g[r][c]=0
for r in range(4,12):
    for c in range(13,19): g[r][c]=0
for r in range(16,22):
    for c in range(3,11): g[r][c]=0
# 1-pattern tiled; source tile at top-right
p1=[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[1,1,0]]
for r in range(2,11):
    for c in range(3,9): g[r][c]=p1[(r-2)%3][(c-6)%3]
# 4-pattern tiled; source tile at bottom-left
p4=[[4,0],[4,4]]
for r in range(4,12):
    for c in range(13,19): g[r][c]=p4[(r-10)%2][(c-13)%2]
# 3-pattern tiled; source tile at bottom-right
p3=[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]]
for r in range(16,22):
    for c in range(3,11): g[r][c]=p3[(r-19)%3][(c-7)%4]
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
